answers.formal_entry_freeze_validation: Reads hard-coded r8 freeze; requires FROZEN_NOT_AUTHORIZED, exact revision, and formal-entry file SHA equal freeze member; then authorization/preflight must bind that freeze SHA.
answers.identity_adapter_binding: Hard-codes r8 freeze path/revision, derives current evaluation bindings, checks current adapter/parent/allocator/transaction/lifecycle/formal-entry hashes against the freeze, and requires authorization revision/hash in PRE_ATTEMPT.
answers.retirement_runner_coupling_evidence: No CURRENT_RUNNER_MATCHES_AUTHORIZATION_FREEZE check exists in retire_unconsumed_authorization. Its authority is the frozen lifecycle contract plus pinned non-reuse determination, immutable issued/unconsumed manifest, no transaction and no matching attempt/reservation/namespace, all under shared lifecycle lock.
answers.freeze_builder_active_auth_zero_requirem: NOT_ESTABLISHED: no dedicated r8/r9 freeze-builder function was found in the inspected implementation. Freeze artifact creation is an offline identity-recording action; current fresh-authorization eligibility separately requires no other active executable authorization. Do not claim that the builder itself enforces zero active authorizations without identifying such code.
answers.historical_pin_semantics: Mixed: the helper pins the current whole lifecycle ledger length and SHA, and also checks a historical 1161-byte prefix SHA. Whole-file pin blocks every legitimate append.
answers.append_failure_mechanism: A terminal retirement event changes both current ledger length and whole-file digest, so strict equality to the pre-retirement 2384-byte file/full SHA fails although the original prefix remains intact.
answers.preflight_old_auth_binding: The available r5 helper constants, authorization manifest hash, freeze hash/revision, fixed identity, and r8-specific preflight ID grammar refer to the already issued r8 authorization; it cannot certify a fresh r9 authorization.

cycle_classification.cycle: Modified formal-entry bytes fail the r8 member hash; r9 execution identity cannot pass r8-hardcoded formal-entry/adapter consumers; current r5 preflight cannot bind r9; retiring r8 is the safe way to clear lifecycle-active authorization before fresh issue, but appending retirement invalidates whole-ledger historical pin equality used by downstream eligibility. Retirement itself does not require current runner equality, and no freeze-builder zero-active-auth gate was established.

namespace_authority.design_constraint: All r9 freeze/auth/attempt/namespace/preflight bindings must converge on one transaction-derived execution identity; do not add a parallel namespace derivation authority.
